scope: End-to-end correctness for chotuBot's documented sample projects and notes, including final-turn answers and specified read-only lookup activity. Excludes general model safety, browser and API contract regressions, and provider availability.

rubric.execution: Use a fresh session per case. Send input.turns in order. Judge only the final reply and any final-turn tool_calls expectations, recording earlier errors separately.
rubric.answers: Pass when the final reply conveys all required_facts, avoids must_not claims, and satisfies any pass_criteria. Equivalent wording and formatting are accepted.
rubric.tools: When tool_calls is specified, match the specified calls by name, exact args, and status for the final turn. For search result_ids, compare the ordered IDs on tool_activity.result.results. Omitted tool_calls leaves the route open.

known_gaps: No production traces were used. Coverage reflects the sample fixture.
project-005 awaits review of whether to require a project status lookup.
No held-out split has been assigned. Assign it after approval, grouping related cases and paraphrases together.
The demo provider is useful for checking API plumbing. Answer quality and multi-turn behavior should be evaluated with the target model.
